parameters.query:
WITH measurement AS (
    SELECT $1::text AS room_id,
           $2::timestamptz AS measured_at,
           $3::double precision AS temperature_c,
           6.0::double precision AS threshold_c
)
INSERT INTO temperature_excursions (
    room_id, measured_at, batch_id, temperature_c, threshold_c
)
SELECT m.room_id,
       m.measured_at,
       (
           SELECT s.batch_id
           FROM batch_storage AS s
           WHERE s.room_id = m.room_id
             AND s.stored_at <= m.measured_at
             AND (s.removed_at IS NULL OR s.removed_at > m.measured_at)
           ORDER BY s.stored_at DESC
           LIMIT 1
       ),
       m.temperature_c,
       m.threshold_c
FROM measurement AS m
WHERE m.temperature_c > m.threshold_c
ON CONFLICT (room_id, measured_at) DO NOTHING
RETURNING room_id, measured_at, batch_id, temperature_c, threshold_c;
